releases.notes:
Continuum Construct 26.1.2-3.11.9.2

Fixes
- Fixed retained tank, gauge, lantern, and casting tank fluids not rendering on item stacks after the block is broken.
- Fixed retained tank item tooltips reading the wrong saved fluid format on some dropped tanks.
- Fixed smeltery drains and ducts losing their structure connection after reloading a world while a redstone faucet was active.
- Fixed casting recipes sometimes staying molten forever if the world was exited before cooling completed.
- Fixed duct filters losing stored copper cans or fluid containers after reloading.
- Fixed modded fluid buckets not being accepted as duct filters.
- Fixed JEI entity melting and severing recipe layouts crashing from mismatched focus links.

Compatibility
- Updated the required Continuum Core dependency to 1.11.7.

## What's Changed
* Neoforge 26.1.2 by @justduck25 in https://github.com/justduck25/Tinker-s-Continuum/pull/11


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/justduck25/Tinker-s-Continuum/compare/0.1.4...0.1.6

releases.notes:
Continuum Construct 26.1.2-3.11.9

New
- Added AllTheModium family material compatibility for Allthemodium, Vibranium, and Unobtainium.
- Added molten fluids, melting recipes, casting recipes, material stats, traits, and generated tool textures for the three main AllTheModium metals.
- AllTheModium materials are made through smeltery casting only; Part Builder recipes are intentionally disabled for these materials.

Improvements
- Updated AllTheModium material colors so Continuum tools better match the original AllTheModium tool palette.
- Added matching harvest tiers for Allthemodium, Vibranium, and Unobtainium harvest tools.

Fixes
- Fixed cleaver/severing drops copying early-loaded recipe outputs with temporary direct item holders, which could spam NBT predicate warnings after pickup.
- Fixed AllTheModium ores refusing to break even when Continuum tools displayed the correct harvest tier.
- Added vanilla tool component syncing so mods that check DataComponents.TOOL can recognize Continuum harvest tools correctly.
- Fixed older Continuum tools missing the new vanilla tool component after loading an existing world.
- Fixed a crash caused by trying to create registry lookups after Minecraft registries were already frozen.

releases.notes:
Continuum Construct 26.1.2-3.11.8

Fixes
- Updated the required library dependency to Continuum Core 1.11.4 after the Mantle fork rename.
- Fixed Luck displaying the wrong vanilla enchantment tooltip on weapons. Swords and launchers now show Looting, fishing rods show Luck of the Sea, and harvest tools show Fortune.
- Fixed Tinker Station and Tinkers' Anvil tool assembly being too strict about internal input slot order.
- Tools can now be assembled as long as the required parts are present in the station inputs, matching the selected tool layout more reliably.
- Added a readable error message for missing tool parts instead of exposing an untranslated recipe key.
- Fixed Continuum Construct JEI categories dropping synced server recipes after joining a world or server.
- Part Builder, casting, melting, modifier, and tool-building recipes now use the recipe map received from the server when JEI builds its displays.
- Fixed a JEI registration crash caused by sorting an immutable synced fuel recipe list.
- Fixed material and tool casting recipes failing on dedicated servers after recipe reload by rebuilding Continuum Construct recipe lookups from the loaded server recipe map.
- Updated the required Continuum Core version to 1.11.4 for the latest recipe decode and sync fixes.

releases.notes:
Tinkers' Continuum 26.1.2-3.11.4

Compatibility
- Added material and tool part compatibility for AE2, Advanced AE, ExtendedAE, Ender IO, Powah, and Jade.
- Added item-only armor part recipes for supported compat materials so armor pieces can be crafted consistently.
- Added world loot integration for generated Tinkers' tools with more controlled modifier pools.
- Added Apotheosis and Apothic Enchanting support for higher modifier caps and vanilla-style enchantment conversion where supported.
- Added safer recipe visibility and conditional loading for optional compat content.

Fixes
- Fixed Smeltery recipe sync crashes caused by missing or empty optional tags, including raw steel materials.
- Fixed slime embellishment recipes by restoring the missing TCon slime embellishment tool tag.
- Fixed several JEI recipe display issues for compat materials, casting, and tool part recipes.
- Fixed luck tooltip and enchantment naming so tools show the correct vanilla-style effect such as Fortune, Looting, or Luck of the Sea.
- Fixed tool loot balance so world-generated tools no longer roll too many random modifiers.
- Fixed common structure loot balance so early-game chests no longer hand out too many high-tier Tinkers' tools or materials.
- Fixed Tinker's Anvil and Scorched Anvil variants so they keep their material/texture when broken and placed again.
- Fixed tool part fallback tooltips so missing material/stat IDs render safely.
- Fixed white or missing models for AE2-family compat materials including Certus Quartz, Fluix, Quantum, and Entro.
- Improved Mantle recipe network errors so broken synced recipes report the failing recipe ID.

Version Safety
- Restricted NeoForge compatibility to 26.1.2.78 or newer, below 26.2, so unsupported loader versions fail with a clear dependency message.
- Verified NeoForge 26.1.2.77 is rejected with the expected loader warning.
